# Rules Checklist: An entity belongs to one resource, and its relations stay inside it

**Purpose**: Requirements quality of every refusal, every link kind, the 1.6 edge, the migration and the tail
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Refusals — completeness and clarity

- [x] CHK001 Is the exact message of each decorator refusal (no resource, not a resource, a base kind, no `@meta`, several resources) specified, not only its existence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, contracts/entity-decorator.md]
- [x] CHK002 Is it stated at which moment each refusal happens — class definition, model build, graph build — for every case 2.1–2.6? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–§FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Is the refusal of `domain=` defined as Python's own `TypeError`, with no custom message promised? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 Is a resource without `@meta` defined as refused, and at which moment? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Is a base kind (`BaseResource`, `BaseStorage`, `BaseGateway`, `BaseController`) defined as refused, with the reason stated? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is the error type of each layer named (decorator, model build, graph build)? [Clarity, Gap → data-model.md]

## Link kinds — coverage

- [x] CHK007 Are association, aggregation and composition each covered on both sides? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK008 Is the inverse side covered as its own case? [Coverage, Spec §US2 sc.3]
- [x] CHK009 Are specialization and generalization covered? [Coverage, Spec §US2 sc.4]
- [x] CHK010 Is a dictionary field covered, and is it stated that dictionaries use the same relation containers? [Coverage, Spec §US2 sc.5]
- [x] CHK011 Is the state type rule defined without a declaration on the state type, and the shared-state case named? [Clarity, Spec §US2 sc.6, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK012 Is a self-relation and an inherited `@entity` defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is the message shape the same for every link kind, with a separate shape for the state type? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, contracts]

## Graph and protocol

- [x] CHK014 Are the edge's type, direction, relationship, `is_dag`, properties and id specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK015 Is the entity's `domain` edge defined as derived from the resource, and kept? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK016 Are both graph-build refusals (edge count, relation across resources) specified with what they name? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK017 Is "byte for byte" defined against a named published file and commit? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, research R5]
- [x] CHK018 Is it guaranteed that the resource node exists for every edge? [Dependency, Spec §Edge Cases, research R4]

## Migration

- [x] CHK019 Are the counts to migrate measured and dated, with the discrepancy against the issue recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK020 Is the demo outcome measurable (every entity one edge, zero crossing relations, a gateway and a cache owning entities, at least 200 entities and relations)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK021 Is it stated that `specs/` history is not migrated? [Scope, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK022 Is the migration of the adapters' tests in scope? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]

## The tail

- [x] CHK023 Is every case required in the documentation as a script and a notebook with real output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK024 Are the reference sections that change named ("Mandatory domain", "Entity relations")? [Clarity, Spec §US5]
- [x] CHK025 Are versions and a one-article changelog required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK026 Is the closing check run at zero remarks a success criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
